description: This file contains unit tests for OpenSSL cryptographic functions, including version checks, counter readings, and algorithm status, using Google Test framework.

methods.name: Version
methods.description: Test that OPENSSL_VERSION_NUMBER and OPENSSL_VERSION_TEXT are consistent.

methods.name: Strndup
methods.description: Test the OPENSSL_strndup function with null input.

methods.name: FIPSCountersEVP
methods.description: Test reading FIPS counters for various EVP cipher algorithms.

methods.name: FIPSCountersEVP_AEAD
methods.description: Test reading FIPS counters for EVP_AEAD algorithms.

methods.name: QueryAlgorithmStatus
methods.description: Test querying the status of cryptographic algorithms.

methods.name: DeprecatedFunction
methods.description: A deprecated static function called within a test to ensure deprecation handling.
